messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #21345 (add metrics_shard index + lightweight migration) is ready for review. Locally ✅ but CI is failing in the postgres matrix (integration-db-test, Postgres 13). We need to land before the deploy freeze starts Wed 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC. Can someone please 👀 and nominate a rebase slot if CI green by EOD Mon? https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/21345

tony: @maya :eyes: I can take a look in ~30m. Do you have the failing CI job link so I can repro?

ci-bot: CI status for PR #21345: integration-db-test (postgres13) FAILED — job: integration-db-postgres13-02 — logs: "ERROR: relation \"metrics_shard\" does not exist at character 15". Rerun: /ci rerun integration-db-postgres13-02

maya: thanks — job link: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/12345 (attached failing log below)

E 2026-03-06T14:12:10Z sql_executor: ERROR: relation \"metrics_shard\" does not exist at character 15
Stack: org.postgres.jdbc.PSQLException: ERROR: relation \"metrics_shard\" does not exist
 at org.postgres.core.v3.QueryExecutorImpl.receiveError

anne: this looks like the ordering in the migration vs the test fixture. I ran the migration locally and saw the same on a fresh DB. Could be a race where the test suite spins up a service before migrations finish.

lucas: Two quick options: 1) ask CI to rerun the job (sometimes flakes), 2) if it's reproducible, push a tiny test tweak to wait for migration completion (or guard the test). If we need a rebase slot we should claim one now — release window is getting tight.

maya: I'm going to rerun the job now and try a local reproduce + small guard. If I can't get green, I'll push a test fix and request a rebase slot.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by maya — integration-db-postgres13-02 queued. Current queue ETA ~12m.

zach_release: @here re: freeze — we have a soft freeze starting 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC. For any PRs needing a rebase slot, please add the label release/needs-rebase and ping #eng-releases with justification. Slots are limited; we prioritize bug fixes and critical migrations.

tony: quick note on repro: I spun up postgres13 + test fixture and hit the same error until I added a 1s sleep after migration apply, which suggests a timing issue rather than schema missing.

maya: update — I pushed a tiny test-guard commit (skip until migration applied) to this branch for CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/21345/commits/aa1b2c. Rerun triggered. If green, can someone approve so we can land before freeze? :pray:

releases-bot: Label added: release/needs-rebase by maya. To request slot, comment: "request-rebase-slot: reason=migration+bugfix, by=maya, ETA=EOD Mon"

lucas: If CI passes, @zach_release can you advise on rebase slot priority? This touches a migration so I'd mark it higher than a pure feature.

zach_release: @lucas noted. If CI is green today, ping me with the PR link and I'll slot it for Tues morning. Otherwise we may need to wait for the post-freeze window.

maya: CI green! integration-db-postgres13-02 ✅. cc @zach_release here is the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/21345

tony: LGTM from me (read-through + local repro).

anne: Approving as well — migration looks safe and rollback tested.

maya: request-rebase-slot: reason=migration+bugfix, by=maya, ETA=EOD Mon

releases-bot: Rebase slot request received. Current queue: 2. Estimated slot: Tue 08:00-10:00 UTC if priority approved.

zach_release: Approved for Tue morning. I'll coordinate rebase and landing; if anything blocks CI again, we hold and defer to next window. Thanks everyone for quick turn. :tada:
